generations.prompt:
Create one original landscape 16:9 bitmap background plate for an existing side-on versus fighting game arena. Native wide output, one single coherent physical room, no panels or collage. The exact scene is Silent Hill 1 (1999), Otherworld Midwich Elementary School, the underground Split Head boss chamber reached by the boiler-room turnstile lift. This is the dark fire-pit boss chamber, NOT the ordinary boiler machinery room, NOT a school corridor or classroom, and NOT a hospital. Reconstruct the source scene without any characters, monster, corpse, blood pile, weapons, lettering, symbols, interface or watermark.

SOURCE OBSERVATIONS TO RESPECT: The licensed Piggyback Silent Hill official guide, printed page 80, shows a dark rusted metal-grid chamber with a bright orange fire in its central metal cage/fire pit, iron grating underfoot and distant metal fencing disappearing into blackness. The existing project reference describes the boiler-room lift descending into the open arena with a fire pit in the middle. The only strongly lit object is the contained hearth. Translate the simple dirty PS1 industrial material language into a detailed, restrained, atmospheric painted game background; do not add fantasy architecture or generic steampunk props.

CAMERA / VERSUS ADAPTATION: Fixed side-view theatrical wide framing, nearly level horizon, slight perspective into the room. A continuous broad horizontal iron-grating floor occupies the bottom 32% of the image; it is unobstructed across the full width and suitable for two full-body fighters. The circular low rusty metal cage around the open hearth sits BEHIND this foreground fighting strip, centered at x=50%, with its orange light centered at y=59%. Keep the cage about 27% of image width, its metal sides from y=51% to y=66%. Small restrained contained orange-yellow fire comes from inside it, never reaches the fighter strip. Fire base and cage must be clear, readable silhouettes. The background corners and distant wire-grid walls sink into deep brown-black shadow. No prominent ceiling plane, no overhead lamps, no boiler tanks, no suspended chains, no doors or secondary rooms, no floor drop in the front strip, no lava or active hazard effects. Keep the top half dark and spacious. Dim copper-orange light grazes the grate locally around the pit; elsewhere muted charcoal and rust brown. Fine aging and corrosion, physically coherent perspective, serious horror atmosphere, readable low-contrast floor. Opaque full-frame background, no transparency. Do not include any separate foreground framing objects; those will be a different PNG.

generations.prompt:
Derive a separate transparent FOREGROUND PARALLAX PLATE matching the attached background, at exactly the same landscape 16:9 canvas and perspective. The final image must be an RGBA PNG with genuine alpha transparency everywhere except two very thin partial rusty metal fence uprights at the extreme left and right edge. This is a separate layer, NOT a second background.

Keep only the visual language and lighting of the supplied Silent Hill 1 Otherworld Midwich hearth chamber. Remove the entire supplied room, all floor, the hearth, all walls, fire, smoke and darkness to true transparency. On the outermost left 0–3% of the canvas and outermost right 97–100%, show two cropped near-camera rusty vertical square iron fence uprights with, at most, tiny cropped metal-grid fragments extending a further 1% inward. The uprights continue offscreen above and below, thin and unobtrusive. Their inner-facing edges receive a subtle dark orange reflected glint from the central hearth. They must remain thin edge details in accurate scale, not huge pillars, pillars in the center, thick bars, door leaves, chains, or a decorative picture frame. No horizontal connecting bar, no floor shadow, no ground strip, no bottom or top border, no haze, vignette, smoke, fire, lighting wash or opaque black backdrop. Absolutely every pixel in the central 90% of image width must have alpha zero, including the bottom. Do not draw characters, corpses, text, symbols or logos. Canvas must match the source background dimensions and wide aspect, with all the empty transparent space preserved. A small camera parallax displacement of 1.2% of width is the only future movement; these edge pieces must not occlude combat.
